Name: Reykjavík Fringe Festival
Company description: Welcome to the annual Reykjavík Fringe Festival, home of the Icelandic grassroots art scene as well as a platform for more established performers to experiment and play. Our artists are a mix of local and international performers, speaking, singing and screaming in a variety of languages - or none at all. The festival takes place at the height of summer, making the most of the long days and the midnight sun. Venues are all in central Reykjavík, a close walking distance from one another. Tickets are affordable and the atmosphere is always welcoming.

Name: Whale Safari
Company description: Whale Safari is Reykavik's and Akureyri´s only small groups whale watching tour operator. Our specially constructed RIB boats are made to get you as close as possible to the whales, dolphins and puffins of the Faxaflói Bay and the famous Eyjafjord humpbacks. Our RIBS only seat 12 passengers per boat, each with an expert whale watching guide and captain on board. All our small group tours are real ocean safaris and the ride on our 450 to 700 horsepower boats is an adventure in itself. On our Reykjavík tours we also visit the puffins when they are in season before searching for the minke and humpback whales, we even do a sightseeing tour of Reykjavík from the sea front. On our Akureyri tours explore the deepest and most beautiful fjord in Iceland before searching for the famous "Eyjafjord Humpbacks"  Oh! And both these tours only less take then two hours. We see whales and/or dolphins on more then 92% of our tours. If we don´t see whales or dolphins on your tour you can try again for free on the Whale Watching Classic or Akureyri Whale Watching any time you like. Our ticket office and service centers are located in the Old Harbour of downtown Reykjavík and next to the Hof Cultural Centre in downtown Akureyri and are open from 8:00-20:00 during the season. Whale and wild life tours are operated up to 7 times a day, everyday from the 15th of April to the 31st of October.  Tours can be booked here online, with an email to info@whalesafari.is or via phone on +354-497-0000.

Name: SAHARA Festival
Company description: SAHARA FESTIVAL- SIMPLIFYING DIGITAL MARKETING We introduce to you SAHARA Festival, a festival-style conference with some of the world’s leading marketing leaders taking to the stage in Reykjavik city with the theme of Simplifying Digital Marketing.  Let the festivities begin! Last year we invited some of the experts in digital marketing worldwide to join us at SAHARA Festival, both to enlighten us and to throw a huge party. Despite some restrictions we had more than 300 people in the packed hall at Gamla Bíó, listening to speakers from industry giants like Nike, TikTok, SEMrush, HubSpot, Diageo, and Spotify, filling us in on the latest trends in the ever-changing world of digital marketing. All this was happening in between concerts by some of the biggest musicians in Iceland, drinks, food, and networking of course! It was such a tremendous success that we have decided to make it an annual event! Therefore we are inviting you again to enjoy a bigger, redefined, and more glamorous SAHARA Festival at The Harpa Concert Hall on the 3rd of November. This time there are no restrictions holding us back, and the festival will be held in collaboration with the Iceland Airwaves Music Festival which takes place over the same weekend in various venues in downtown Reykjavík. A ticket to SAHARA Festival also grants you access to all concerts at Iceland Airwaves. We are of course inviting world-class speakers from industry leaders in the field of social media and digital marketing. We aim for the lectures to be informative and entertaining, and to benefit both newcomers and experts in the area alike. The vibe we strive to maintain is a lively cross between an informal marketing conference and a joyous celebration. We sincerely ask for your help in achieving that vibe, please come join us in November and have some FUN at SAHARA Festival!

Name: GunHil
Company description: GunHil ltd. is founded by a seasoned producer and a creative person who have been collaborating for over 30 years in the creative industries. Hilmar Sigurdsson is the CEO and Producer of the company and Gunnar Karlsson is the creative force behind many of Iceland‘s most spectacular film ventures.    After having spearheaded and built up Iceland’s first ever animation production company and studio as CEO and Creative Director, they parted at year end 2011 and formed their own production company with the aim of producing Animated Feature Film. This time, they put their own names to the new venture. Shortly after formation, Haukur Sigurjonsson joined the company to lead the opening of an office in Malmö, Sweden. Haukur has a vast new media and gaming production experience and is the key player in tying in GunHil’s properties with the vast opportunities that lie within all the new platforms. GunHil released its first Animated Feature Film in beginning of 2018 entitled ‘PLOEY – You Never Fly Alone’, which did well at box-office in diverse countries like France, Poland, Mexico and Turkey and ended up being sold for Theatrical release in over 70 countries by Playmaker (formerly ARRI Media International). Ploey has highest worldwide box-office attendance of any Icelandic film. GunHil was purchased by Sagafilm, Iceland’s leading and oldest production company in 2017 with Hilmar taking the role of CEO of the group. In July 2023, Gunnar and Hilmar bought back the company which still bears their own names.
